title: Why DeVonta Smith doesn't want to hear he's now Eagles' No. 1 wide receiver

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Why DeVonta Smith doesn't want to hear he's now Eagles' No. 1 wide receiver
sources.description: DeVonta Smith isn't focused on labels, but with A.J. Brown gone, the Eagles star enters 2026 as the team's top wide receiver.
